summary: Iteration 2: 4 new feature groups (Case Studies, PDF Resume, Hire widget, Analytics + Share) fully verified. Backend pytest 10/10 pass (root + contact regression + hire + analytics + resume). Frontend Playwright: hire fab/panel/3 rate cards work, hire submit POSTs /api/hire and closes modal; share fab/panel with 4 social links (correct hrefs) + copy button; resume button in nav/hero/contact all trigger GET /api/resume (application/pdf, %PDF- header, Anaita_Pal_Resume.pdf disposition); all 4 project cards route to /work/:slug; case study pages render root/title/5 sections (cover/problem/approach/screens/outcomes) for antirag, fast-meal, cyberfiction, ai-voice-assistant; back link returns to /, next cycles to next slug; analytics summary shows total_events=74 with section_view + case_study_view + resume_download + hire_submit + share_open types.
